rate_meaning: One unit of USD equals rates[target] units of the target currency.
chain_rule: Each switch reads the canonical USD amount. A previous display number is never the next input.
identity: USD uses rate 1 because it is the base currency, not because a cross rate was invented.
on_fetch_failure: Use a cached book only when its age is within max_cache_age_hours. Otherwise keep the prior display currency and surface EXCHANGE RATE UNAVAILABLE. TRY AGAIN SHORTLY.
missing_code: A missing or non-positive rate is omitted. It is not replaced with 1.
precision: The cached rate stays at provider precision. Intl rounding applies only to the displayed string.
disclosure: The Ask Jurnl sheet may show RATE UPDATED and 1 USD = X TARGET. The main Today and Activity surfaces do not.
